notes.title: Demo Update! (v0.5)
notes.notes:
Hello, Paw-City railroad designers! 

We are pleased to announce an update to 


Sudden Event Level System! 


A level system has been introduced for sudden events. 

Floods occur less frequently early on, but later stages may see sudden floods erupting in multiple locations. 

Put your strategy and know-how to the test!


Improved Carriage Movement! 
We've fixed the unnatural movement when using carriage items. 

Now enjoy carriages that move naturally along the route! 


Balance Adjustments!   


Our goal is to get more players enjoying the strategy genre. 

We've adjusted the balance accordingly. 

Challenge yourself to achieve your personal best score!

 

 
If you have any bugs or feedback while playing, please join our Discord channel below or Steam Community! 

DISCORD


 We'll even honor the most prolific bug reporters with a mention in the "Thanks to credits"! 

We hope you continue to love  and stay tuned! 
Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Update! (v0.4)
notes.notes:
Hello, Paw-City railroad designers! 


We are pleased to announce an update to  for the BIC Festival!


Tutorial update!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396160/0caa670a60a541ad10295cd01451b3540f7250c9.png"]



The tutorial has been changed from one that simply conveys information to one that allows you to learn by playing the game yourself.

Learn the game more easily and simply, and enjoy playing it!




Additional effects!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396160/d96390d94d29568b40c6e659b5823eeefb897102.png"]

Many effects have been added to sudden events.

We will show you where unexpected events will occur through cutscenes, starting with warnings before the events occur.

We plan to continue updating the game to enable more strategic route design.




Loading Screen Update!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396160/27dbd399a9258d267aca8405d52d7ece1f460f01.png"]

Now, the loading screen features the Mole Team, the best construction team in Paw City.

There is also a helpful tip for the game, and you can change the tip content by clicking the mouse!

We'll even honor the most prolific bug reporters with a mention in the "Thanks to credits"!

notes.title: Demo Bug fix
notes.notes:
Hello, Paw-City railroad designers! 




We have fixed some bugs found in the demo update on May 31. 


1. Item Bug 
- Fixed a bug where items were not used properly in certain situations, causing trains to disappear or tracks to break. 


2. Boarding Bug 
- Fixed a bug where animal residents did not board trains in certain situations. 


3. Track Deletion Bug 
- Fixed a bug where trains did not operate after deleting and reinstalling tracks.





If you have any bugs or feedback while playing, please join our Discord channel below or Steam Community!

notes.title: 2nd Demo Update!

UI Update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396160/00bd66c074933038329cc6bddf17105ea42a32da.png

We have completely updated the in-game UI.
Now, you can see when you will obtain items and what situations will arise while playing the game.


Railroad edit system!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396160/3a04463da6e2ba9b1d1e8f6d12abf00b4c8cb613.gif

Deleting and reinstalling railroads may have been inconvenient.
But now you can edit the railroads you have installed!
Try playing more strategically by editing your railroads!


Español added!

Spanish has been added in this demo update.
We hope that many Spanish-speaking railway designers will enjoy playing the game.

notes.title: First Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, Paw-City railroad designers!
After a long time in preparation, we are pleased to announce the first demo update of !

New design!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396160/1a414379e93d1c5be620c0025e1b8146cdac6b5c.gif

We've completely changed the look of Animal Town, its Animal residents, and the railroad.
Animal towns and their Animal residents have been redesigned to look cuter.

Railroads that were previously straight lines have been designed to look more like train tracks, and we've also added scenery to them.


Item system!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396160/2ea29c1b34899c9326101a78968b7ec9773a7030.gif

We've added a system to give you items to help you play.
Choose new railroad or new trains to play more strategically!


Sudden Events!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396160/73530d092870733fd8e7adafff6453795311a71d.gif

Disasters will suddenly strike and interrupt your play.
Note that trains will travel slower in rainy areas!

Currently, we've added one flash event, Flood, and will be adding Meteor and Heavy Snow in the future.


New languages added!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396160/3ee7359ffb3b38ffc083b48287a90b5e777c3b46.png

We now support six languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Russian, and Korean.
We'll be adding more languages over time so that more railroad designers around the world can play the game.




If you have any bugs or feedback while playing, please join our Discord channel below or Steam Community!

We'll even honor the most prolific bug reporters with a mention in the "Thanks to credits"!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396160/6e2503522ef89a40a4aa79cb6335d37be676be9f.png

We hope you continue to love  and stay tuned!
Thank you!
